description: This Java class implements the ApplicationInfoDao interface and provides a method to load application information from a database table named 'app_info' using JDBC. It extends an abstract DAO class and uses Spring's @Repository annotation for persistence management.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for data access object to retrieve application info records from the database.

methods.name: loadApplicationInfos
methods.description: Retrieves a list of AppInfo objects from the database table 'app_info'.
